name: sphior-code-guard
description: Scans every file your agent writes or edits with SPHIOR CODE's deterministic rules (secrets, CWE patterns, taint flows) and hands high-severity findings straight back, so the agent fixes them before moving on. Runs locally, no account needed.

interface.longDescription: After every file Codex writes or patches, SPHIOR CODE scans that file with deterministic rules for hard-coded secrets, insecure patterns mapped to CWE and taint flows. High-severity findings go straight back to Codex with the line, the reason and how to fix it, so it fixes them before moving on. Runs locally with the open-source CLI; no account, API key or source upload.
